mt shift(const mt &a, int shift)
{
    int k = K;
    int n = k + 1;
    shift = (k - shift) % k;
    mt res = a;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
            res[i * n + j] = a[((i + shift) % k) * n + ((j + shift) % k)];
        }
    }
    for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
        res[k * n + j] = a[k * n + ((j + shift) % k)];
    }
    return res;
}

    mt res(n * n, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {

            res[i * n + j] = tmp;
        }
    }
    return res;

                curx ^= (1 << i);
            }
            bs = bs * shift(bs, (1 << i));
